# agentic-device

Control your own iPhones for posting via WebDriverAgent and ESP32 HID.

Keywords: iphone,esp32,webdriveragent,device,agentic-suite,cli,mcp.

- SDK: import { summarizeText, dispatchText } from "agentic-device".
- CLI: agentic-device summary --text "...".
- MCP: run agentic-device mcp, then call summarize_text.

## Docs

- README: https://github.com/pooriaarab/agentic-device
